stem: Hema records morning body temperatures of three healthy classmates: 36.7 °C, 36.9 °C, and 37.2 °C.

options.text: All three can be healthy; 37.0 °C is a typical average, not an exact reading every healthy person must show.
Only readings above 37.0 °C can be healthy.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Healthy body temperature varies a little around about 37 °C, so 36.7 °C, 36.9 °C, and 37.2 °C can all be normal.

teacher.key_rationale: 37.0 °C is a useful average, not a single exact value every healthy person must match. Small differences around it are usual; requiring exact 37.0 °C or only values above it is wrong.
